verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat aapaa khoi gur dhaas hoi baal budh sudh na karat moh dhroh kee ||

en.bdb: One becomes true disciple only by getting the divine word of Guru absorbed in the mind and becoming a humble slave of the Guru. For virtually a possessor of the child-like wisdom, he is free of deceit and infatuations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਮ ਤੁਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੋਚਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਉ ਲੋਹ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sravan usatat ni(n)dhaa sam tul surat liv lochan dhiaan liv ka(n)chan aau loh kee ||

en.bdb: Since his consciousness is engrossed in the name of the Lord; he is least affected by praise or rejection.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਬੋਹ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: naasakaa suga(n)dh biraga(n)dh samasar taa kai jihabaa samaan bikh a(n)mrit na boh kee ||

en.bdb: Fragrance and foul smell, poison or elixir are the same for him, because his (devotee's) conscious is absorbed in Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰ ਚਰ ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਅਪਥ ਪਥ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਸਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੀ ॥੧੦੭॥
verses.translit_en: kar char karam akaram apath path kirat birat sam ukat na dhroh kee ||107||

en.bdb: He remains stable and uniform even if he uses his hands in good or indifferent deeds; or treads path not worthy of appreciation. Such a devotee never harbours any feeling of deceit, falsehood or ill deeds. (107)
